signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 176 — "Dangerous curve". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You are approaching a sharp or dangerous curve to the right. You must reduce your speed and be prepared to steer accordingly.
meaning.nb: Du nærmer deg en krapp eller farlig sving til høyre. Du må redusere farten og være beredt på å svinge deretter.

name.en: Dangerous curves, first to the right

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 176 — "Dangerous curves". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You are approaching a section of road with dangerous curves, where the first curve goes to the right. You must reduce your speed and prepare to steer carefully through the turns.
meaning.nb: Du nærmer deg en veistrekning med farlige svinger, hvor den første svingen går til høyre. Du må redusere farten og forberede deg på å svinge forsiktig gjennom svingene.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 177 — "Steep hill — upwards". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You are approaching a steep uphill gradient. You must be prepared for reduced vehicle performance and adjust your speed and gear accordingly.
meaning.nb: Du nærmer deg en bratt stigning. Du må være forberedt på redusert motor- og kjøretøykapasitet og tilpasse fart og gir deretter.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 177 — "Steep hill — downwards". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You are approaching a steep downward slope. You must adapt your speed and use engine braking to maintain control.
meaning.nb: Du nærmer deg en bratt nedoverbakke. Du må avpasse farten og benytte motorbrems for å beholde kontrollen over kjøretøyet.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 178 — "Road narrows — on both sides". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You are approaching a section where the road narrows from both sides. You must reduce your speed and be prepared to share the road with oncoming traffic.
meaning.nb: Du nærmer deg en strekning der vegen smalner inn fra begge sider. Du må sette ned farten og være forberedt på å dele vegen med motgående trafikk.

name.en: Road narrows — on the right side

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 178 — "Road narrows — on the right side". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign warns you that the road narrows from the right side ahead. You must adjust your speed and position to pass the narrowing safely.
meaning.nb: Skiltet varsler om at veien smalner fra høyre side lenger framme. Du må tilpasse hastighet og plassering for å passere innsnevringen på en sikker måte.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 179 — "Uneven road". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You must prepare for an uneven road surface that may cause bouncing or affect vehicle control. Reduce your speed to maintain safety and comfort.
meaning.nb: Du må gjøre deg klar for en ujevn vegflate som kan føre til støt eller påvirke bilens veigrep og styring. Tilpass farten for å opprettholde sikkerheten og komforten.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 179 — "Road hump". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign warns you of a road hump ahead. You must reduce your speed to cross the hump safely without damaging your vehicle.
meaning.nb: Skiltet varsler om en fartshump lenger framme. Du må sette ned farten for å passere humpen på en trygg måte uten å skade kjøretøyet.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 180 — "Road work". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You must reduce your speed and show extra caution because there is ongoing road work ahead. Watch out for workers, machinery, and sudden changes in traffic conditions.
meaning.nb: Du må redusere farten og vise ekstra aktsomhet fordi det pågår veiarbeid lenger fremme. Vær oppmerksom på veiarbeidere, maskiner og plutselige endringer i trafikkforholdene.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 180 — "Loose chippings". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You must be aware of loose stones on the road surface that can be thrown up by vehicles. You should reduce your speed and increase the following distance to avoid vehicle damage.
meaning.nb: Du må være oppmerksom på løse steiner på veibanen som kan bli kastet opp av kjøretøy. Du bør redusere hastigheten og øke avstanden til forankjørende for å unngå kjøretøyskader.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 181 — "Landslide". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign warns you of the danger of falling rocks or landslides on the road ahead. You must be prepared to look out for obstacles on the roadway.
meaning.nb: Skiltet advarer deg om fare for steinsprang eller ras på veien lenger framme. Du må være forberedt på å se etter hindringer på kjørebanen.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 181 — "Landslide". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You must watch out for falling rocks or stones on the road ahead. Be prepared to reduce your speed and look out for obstacles on the pavement.
meaning.nb: Du må være oppmerksom på fare for steinsprang eller raste steiner i veibanen. Vær forberedt på å redusere farten og se etter hindringer i veien.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 182 — "Slippery road". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You must be prepared for reduced friction and slippery road conditions ahead.
meaning.nb: Du må være forberedt på redusert veigrep og glatte kjøreforhold lenger fremme.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 182 — "Dangerous shoulder". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You must be aware of a potentially dangerous or unstable road shoulder ahead. Drive carefully and avoid driving too close to the edge of the road.
meaning.nb: Du må være oppmerksom på en potensielt farlig eller ustabil vegkant lenger framme. Kjør forsiktig og unngå å kjøre for langt ut mot vegkanten.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 183 — "Opening or swing bridge". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You are approaching an opening or swing bridge where traffic may be stopped. Be prepared to stop.
meaning.nb: Du nærmer deg en bevegelig bru der trafikken kan bli stanset. Vær forberedt på å stoppe.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 183 — "Quayside or river bank". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign warns you that the road leads onto a quayside, river bank, or other unbarricaded body of water. You must exercise extreme caution to avoid driving into the water.
meaning.nb: Skiltet varsler om at veien ender ved kai, elvebredd eller annet uavsperret vann. Du må være svært forsiktig slik at du ikke kjører ut i vannet.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 184 — "Tunnel". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign warns you that you are approaching a tunnel ahead. You must turn on your vehicle's headlights before entering.
meaning.nb: Skiltet varsler om at du nærmer deg en tunnel. Du må slå på bilens lys før du kjører inn.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 184 — "Dangerous junction". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You are approaching a junction where the general rule of yield to the right applies. You must be prepared to yield to traffic coming from the right.
meaning.nb: Du nærmer deg et kryss hvor den generelle vikepliktsregelen fra høyre gjelder. Du må være forberedt på å víke for trafikk som kommer fra høyre.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 185 — "Roundabout". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign warns you that you are approaching a roundabout. You must be prepared to yield the right-of-way to traffic already in the roundabout.
meaning.nb: Skiltet varsler om at du nærmer deg en rundkjøring. Du må være oppmerksom og forberedt på å gi vikeplikt for trafikken som allerede er i rundkjøringen.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 185 — "Traffic signals". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You are approaching a traffic light signal ahead. You must be prepared to stop if the signal shows red or yellow.
meaning.nb: Du nærmer deg et trafikklysanlegg. Du må være forberedt på å stoppe hvis signalet viser rødt eller gult lys.

name.en: Level crossing with a gate or barrier

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 186 — "Level crossing with a gate or barrier". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You are approaching a railway level crossing equipped with gates or barriers. You must reduce your speed and be prepared to stop if the barrier is closed or closing.
meaning.nb: Du nærmer deg en jernbaneplanovergang med bom. Du må avpasse farten og være beredt til å stanse hvis bommen er stengt eller under lukking.

name.en: Level crossing without a gate or barrier

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 186 — "Level crossing without a gate or barrier". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You are approaching a level crossing without gates or barriers. You must be extra observant and yield to any approaching train before crossing.
meaning.nb: Du nærmer deg en planovergang uten bom. Du må være ekstra aktsom og vike for eventuelle tog før du krysser sporet.

name.en: Countdown marker for a level crossing

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 187 — "Countdown marker". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates the final third part of the distance to a railway level crossing ahead. Each stripe represents approximately one-third of the total distance to the crossing.
meaning.nb: Dette skiltet viser den siste tredjedelen av avstanden frem til en jernbaneovergang. Hver stripe representerer omtrent en tredjedel av den totale avstanden til overgangen.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 187 — "Countdown marker". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates the distance to a railway level crossing. Each stripe represents approximately one-third of the distance to the crossing.
meaning.nb: Dette skiltet viser avstanden til en planovergang. Hver stripe representerer omtrent en tredjedel av avstanden fram til planovergangen.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 188 — "Countdown marker". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This marker counts down the distance to a railway level crossing. Each stripe represents approximately one-third of the distance to the crossing.
meaning.nb: Denne tavlen viser avstanden fram til en planovergang. Hver stripe representerer omtrent en tredjedel av avstanden fram til planovergangen.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 188 — "Level crossing — single track". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You are approaching a level crossing with a single track. You must be prepared to yield to trains.
meaning.nb: Du nærmer deg en planovergang med ett spor. Du må være beredt på å vike for tog.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 188 — "Level crossing — multiple tracks". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You are approaching a level crossing with two or more railway tracks. You must be extra observant as one train may hide another after it has passed.
meaning.nb: Du nærmer deg en planovergang med to eller flere jernbanespor. Du må være ekstra oppmerksom siden ett tog kan skjule et annet etter at det har passert.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 189 — "Tramway". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign warns you that you are approaching a tram line or an area where trams cross or run along the road. You must be prepared to give way to trams and exercise extra caution.
meaning.nb: Skiltet advarsel om at du nærmer deg en trikkelinje eller et område der trikker krysser eller følger vegen. Du må være oppmerksom på trikk og vise aktsomhet.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 189 — "Distance to pedestrian crossing". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign warns you that you are approaching a pedestrian crossing in 150 metres. You must reduce your speed and be prepared to yield to pedestrians.
meaning.nb: Skiltet advarer deg om at du nærmer deg et fotgjengerfelt om 150 meter. Du må sette ned farten og være beredt til å vike for gående.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 190 — "Children". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You must be prepared for children suddenly entering the road. Reduce your speed and pay close attention.
meaning.nb: Du må være forberedt på at barn plutselig kan komme ut i veien. Sett ned farten og vær spesielt oppmerksom.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 190 — "Cyclist". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign warns you that cyclists frequently cross or ride along the road ahead. You must be prepared to reduce your speed and show consideration.
meaning.nb: Skiltet varsler om at syklende ofte krysser eller følger veien lenger fremme. Du må være forberedt på å redusere farten og vise hensyn.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 191 — "Moose". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You must be prepared for moose frequently crossing or walking along the road. Reduce your speed and maintain extra vigilance.
meaning.nb: Du må være forberedt på at elg ofte krysser eller ferdes langs veien. Reduser hastigheten og vær ekstra oppmerksom.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 191 — "Reindeer". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign warns you that reindeer frequently cross or appear on the road ahead. You must reduce your speed and remain extra alert.
meaning.nb: Skiltet varsler om at det ofte ferdes reinsdyr på vegstrekningen. Du må redusere farten og være ekstra oppmerksom.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 192 — "Deer". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You must watch out for deer or other large wild animals that may unexpectedly cross the road.
meaning.nb: Du må være oppmerksom på hjort eller andre store viltpattedyr som uventet kan krysse veien.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 192 — "Cattle". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign warns you that cattle may cross or be present on the road. You must reduce your speed and be prepared to stop.
meaning.nb: Skiltet varsler om at det kan være storfe på eller i nærheten av vegbanen. Du må redusere farten og være beredt på å stanse.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 192 — "Sheep". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You must be prepared for sheep on or near the road.
meaning.nb: Du må være forberedt på sau på eller i nærheten av veien.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 193 — "Two-way traffic". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign warns you that you are approaching a road section with two-way traffic, typically after a stretch with one-way traffic or divided lanes. Be prepared to meet oncoming traffic.
meaning.nb: Skiltet advarer deg om at du nærmer deg en veistrekning med tovegs trafikk, typisk etter en strekning med enevegs trafikk eller atskilte kjørebaner. Vær oppmerksom på møtende trafikk.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 193 — "Traffic queues likely". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You must be prepared for slow-moving traffic or stationary queues ahead. Reduce your speed and maintain extra distance to the vehicle in front of you.
meaning.nb: Du må være forberedt på saktegående trafikk eller stillestående kø lenger fremme. Reduser farten og hold god avstand til kjøretøyet foran deg.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 194 — "Low-flying aircraft". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You must be prepared for low-flying aircraft that may cause sudden noise or distractions. Watch out for aircraft taking off or landing near airports.
meaning.nb: Du må være forberedt på lavtflygende luftfartøy som kan forårsake plutselig støy eller avledning. Vær oppmerksom på fly som tar av eller lander i nærheten av flyplasser.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 194 — "Crosswinds". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You must be prepared for strong crosswinds that can affect the vehicle's steering, especially in exposed areas.
meaning.nb: Du må være forberedt på sterk sidevind som kan påvirke bilens retningsstabilitet, særlig på utsatte strekninger.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 195 — "Traffic accident". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You must be prepared for a traffic accident ahead and reduce your speed. Drive with extra caution and be ready to stop or maneuver around the danger.
meaning.nb: Du må være forberedt på ulykke lenger nå og redusere farten. Kjør med ekstra aktsomhet og vær beredt på å stoppe eller manøvrere rundt faremomentet.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 195 — "Skiers". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign warns you that skiers frequently cross or move along the road ahead. You must reduce your speed and be prepared to stop for skiers.
meaning.nb: Skiltet varsler om at skiløpere ofte krysser eller ferdes langs veien. Du må redusere farten og være beredt til å stanse for skiløpere.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 195 — "Riders". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You must be prepared for riders on or near the road. Reduce your speed and give them plenty of space when passing.
meaning.nb: Du må være forberedt på ryttere på eller nær veien. Reduser farten og gi dem god plass ved forbikjøring eller passering.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 196 — "Other danger". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You must be prepared for a hazard or danger on or near the road that is not covered by any other specific warning sign. An additional panel usually describes the nature of the danger.
meaning.nb: Du må være forberedt på en fare på eller ved veien som ikke dekkes av noe annet spesifikt fareskilt. En undersone angir vanligvis hva faren gjelder.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 197 — "Give way". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You must yield the right-of-way to vehicles on the intersecting road. You may only proceed when it is safe and will not cause hindrance or danger to others.
meaning.nb: Du må gi forkjørsel til kjøretøy på den kryssende veien. Du kan bare kjøre videre når det er trygt og ikke vil medføre hindring eller fare for andre.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 197 — "Stop". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You must stop completely before entering an intersection or crossing a continuous stop line. You must also yield the right-of-way to traffic on the intersecting road.
meaning.nb: Du må stanse helt før du kjører inn i et kryss eller passerer en heldratt stopplinje. Du må også the vikeplikt for all trafikk på den kryssende veien.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 198 — "Priority road". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that you are driving on a priority road where oncoming and intersecting traffic must yield to you. Drivers entering from side roads have a duty to give way.
meaning.nb: Skiltet angir at du kjører på en veg der trafikk fra sidene har vikeplikt for deg. Kjøretøyer som kommer fra sideveger, har vikeplikt.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 198 — "End of priority road". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that the priority road ends. From this point on, standard right-of-way rules apply unless otherwise indicated.
meaning.nb: Skiltet angir at forkjørsvegen slutter. Fra dette punktet gjelder de vanlige vikepliktsreglene med mindre annet er angitt.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 199 — "Priority junction". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You are approaching a junction where you have priority over traffic from side roads. The symbol shows the layout of the junction.
meaning.nb: Du nærmer deg et veikryss der du har forkjørsrett over trafikk fra sideveier. Symbolet viser formen på krysset.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 199 — "Give way for oncoming traffic". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You must give way to oncoming traffic when the roadway is too narrow for two vehicles to pass safely.
meaning.nb: Du må vike for møtende trafikk når kjørebanen er for smal til at to kjøretøy kan passere trygt.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 200 — "Priority over oncoming traffic". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You have priority over oncoming traffic in a narrow section of the road. Oncoming drivers must yield to you.
meaning.nb: Du har forkjørsrett over møtende trafikk på en smal veistrekning. Møtende kjøretøy har vikeplikt for deg.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 200 — "No entry". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You must not drive past this sign into the road or area. It prohibits entry for all vehicles.
meaning.nb: Du kan ikke kjøre forbi dette skiltet inn i veien eller området. Det forbikjøring forbudt gjelder innkjøring for alle kjøretøy.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 201 — "No vehicles". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You must not drive past this sign. It prohibits traffic in both directions for all types of vehicles.
meaning.nb: Du kan ikke kjøre forbi dette skiltet. Det forbød trafikk i begge retninger for alle typer kjøretøy.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 201 — "No motor vehicles". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You are prohibited from driving any motor vehicle past this sign. This applies to cars, motorcycles, and other motor-driven vehicles.
meaning.nb: Det er forbudt å kjøre motorvogn forbi dette skiltet. Forbudet gjelder biler, motorsykler og andre motorkjøretøy.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 202 — "No tractors or motor vehicles slower than 40 km/h". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You are not allowed to drive a tractor past this sign.
meaning.nb: Du har ikke lov til å kjøre traktor forbi dette skiltet.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 202 — "No motorcycles or mopeds". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign prohibits motorcycles and mopeds from driving past the sign. You must choose another route if you are driving this type of vehicle.
meaning.nb: Skiltet forbyr motorsykler og mopeder å kjøre forbi skiltet. Du må velge en annen rute hvis du kjører denne kjøretøytypen.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 203 — "No Lorries". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You are prohibited from driving a lorry or goods vehicle past this sign. The restriction applies to heavy goods vehicles.
meaning.nb: Det er forbudt å kjøre lastebil eller trekkbil forbi dette skiltet. Forbudet gjelder tunge kjøretøy for godstransport.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 203 — "No cyclists". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that cycling is prohibited. You must not ride a bicycle past this sign.
meaning.nb: Skiltet angir at det er forbudt å sykle. Du kan ikke sykle forbi dette skiltet.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 204 — "No pedestrians". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that pedestrians are prohibited from entering or using the road or area.
meaning.nb: Skiltet angir at det er forbudt for fotgjengere å ferdes på veien eller i området.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 204 — "No pedestrians or cyclists". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that pedestrians and cyclists are prohibited from using the road or path.
meaning.nb: Skiltet angir at det er forbudt for gående og syklende å bruke veien eller stien.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 205 — "No riders". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that riding horses is prohibited.
meaning.nb: Skiltet angir at det er forbudt å ri på hest.

name.nb: Forbud mot transport av farlig gods

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 205 — "No transport of dangerous goods". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You are prohibited from driving a vehicle transporting dangerous goods past this sign.
meaning.nb: Det er forbudt å kjøre kjøretøy som transportere farlig gods forbi dette skiltet.

name.en: No motor vehicles with more than two wheels and total weight above the stated weight
name.nb: Forbud mot motorvogn med mer enn to hjul og med aktuell totalvekt over angitt vekt

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 206 — "No motor vehicles with more than two wheels and total weight above the stated weight". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You are prohibited from driving a motor vehicle with more than two wheels if its total weight exceeds the stated limit.
meaning.nb: Det er forbudt å kjøre motorvogn med mer enn to hjul dersom aktuell totalvekt overstiger den angitte vekten.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 206 — "Width limit". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You must not drive a vehicle whose overall width, including load, exceeds the limit shown on the sign.
meaning.nb: Du kan ikke kjøre et kjøretøy der den største bredden inklusive last overstiger det som er angitt på skiltet.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 207 — "Height limit". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You must not drive a vehicle with a total height exceeding the limit shown on the sign.
meaning.nb: Du kan ikke kjøre et kjøretøy med en totalhøyde som overstiger grensen vist på skiltet.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 207 — "Length limit". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that the road is prohibited for vehicles or vehicle combinations whose total length exceeds the stated limit. You must not drive past this sign if your vehicle or combination is longer than the specified length.
meaning.nb: Skiltet angir at vegen er stengt for kjøretøy eller vogntog med større samlet lengde enn angitt. Du kan ikke kjøre forbi dette skiltet dersom kjøretøyet eller vogntoget ditt er lengre enn den angitte lengden.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 208 — "Weight limit for vehicles". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You must not drive a vehicle or combination of vehicles whose actual total weight exceeds the specified limit.
meaning.nb: Du kan ikke kjøre et kjøretøy eller vogntog der den aktuelle totalvekten overstiger den angitte grensen.

name.en: Weight Limit for Heavy Vehicles with Trailer

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 208 — "Weight limit for Lorries". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that driving is prohibited if the total weight of the truck and trailer combination exceeds the stated limit. You must ensure that your vehicle combination does not weigh more than the indicated tonnage before passing the sign.
meaning.nb: Skiltet angir at det er forbudt å kjøre dersom vogntogets samlede vekt overstiger den angitte grensen. Du må kontrollere at kjøretøykombinasjonen din ikke veier mer enn den angitte tonnasjen før du passerer skiltet.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 209 — "Axle weight limit". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You must not drive a vehicle with an axle weight exceeding the stated limit.
meaning.nb: Du kan ikke kjøre et kjøretøy med aksellast som overstiger den angitte grensen.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 209 — "Bogie weight limit". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign prohibits driving with a bogie weight exceeding the indicated limit. You must ensure your vehicle's bogie weight does not exceed the specified tonnes.
meaning.nb: Skiltet forbyr kjøring med boggivekt som overstiger den angitte grensen. Du må sørge for at kjøretøyets boggivekt ikke overstiger de angitte tonnene.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 210 — "Stop for stated purpose (control)". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You must stop where indicated for the purpose specified on the sign, such as a customs or police control.
meaning.nb: Du må stoppe der det er angitt for det formålet som er spesifisert på skiltet, for eksempel toll- eller politikontroll.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 210 — "Stop for customs". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You must stop for customs clearance. You may only proceed after clearing customs or when permitted by customs personnel.
meaning.nb: Du må stanse for tollklarering. Du kan bare kjøre videre etter tollklarering eller når tollmyndighetene tillater det.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 211 — "No right turn". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You are prohibited from turning to the right at the upcoming intersection or junction.
meaning.nb: Det er forbudt å svinge til høyre i det kommende kryss eller avkjøring.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 211 — "No left turn". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You are prohibited from turning left at the upcoming intersection or junction. You must choose another route.
meaning.nb: Det er forbudt å svinge til venstre i det kommende krysset eller vegdelingen. Du må velge en annen rute.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 212 — "No U-turn". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You are prohibited from making a U-turn to drive in the opposite direction.
meaning.nb: Det er forbudt å snu for å kjøre i motsatt retning.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 212 — "No passing". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You must not overtake motor vehicles with more than two wheels. Passing two-wheeled vehicles without a sidecar is permitted.
meaning.nb: Du har ikke lov til å kjøre forbi motorvogner med mer enn to hjul. Forbikjøring av tohjuls motorvogner uten sidevogn er tillatt.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 213 — "No passing for lorries". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign prohibits drivers of heavy goods vehicles from overtaking moving motor vehicles with more than two wheels. Lighter vehicles are not bound by this restriction.
meaning.nb: Skiltet forbyr fører av lastebil å kjøre forbi kjøretøy i fart med mer enn to hjul. Lettere kjøretøy er ikke omfattet av dette forbudet.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 213 — "End of no passing". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign marks the end of the prohibition against overtaking other motor vehicles. You may now pass other vehicles if conditions allow.
meaning.nb: Dette skiltet markerer slutten på forbudet mot å kjøre forbi andre motorvogner. Du kan nå kjøre forbi andre kjøretøy dersom forholdene tillater det.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 214 — "End of no passing for lorries". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign marks the end of the prohibition on overtaking other motor vehicles. You may now pass other vehicles where it is otherwise safe and legal.
meaning.nb: Skiltet markerer slutten på forbudet mot å kjøre forbi andre motorvogner. Du kan nå kjøre forbi andre kjøretøy der det ellers er trygt og tillatt.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 214 — "Speed limit". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You must not exceed the speed limit of 60 kilometres per hour. The limit applies from the sign and until a new speed limit sign is posted.
meaning.nb: Du kan ikke kjøre raskere enn fartsgrensen på 60 kilometer i timen. Grensen gjelder fra skiltet og fram til et nytt fartsgrenseskilt er satt opp.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 215 — "End of speed limit". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign marks the end of a specific speed limit. You must follow the general speed limits for the road type or any new speed limit signs.
meaning.nb: Dette skiltet markerer slutten på en bestemt fartsgrense. Du må forholde deg til de generelle fartsgrensene for vegtypen eller nye fartsgrenseskilt.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 215 — "Speed limit zone". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You are entering a zone where the maximum permitted speed is 30 km/h. This speed limit applies to all streets within the zone until you pass a zone exit sign.
meaning.nb: Du kjører inn i en sone hvor høyeste tillatte fart er 30 km/t. Denne fartsgrensen gjelder for alle gater innenfor sonen til du passerer et soneslutt-skilt.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 216 — "End of speed limit zone". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign marks the end of a speed limit zone. The general speed limits now apply.
meaning.nb: Skiltet markerer slutten på en fartsgrensesone. De generelle fartsgrensene gjelder nå.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 216 — "No stopping". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You must not stop your vehicle on the side of the road where this sign applies. Stopping for passenger boarding or unloading goods is also prohibited.
meaning.nb: Du kan ikke stanse kjøretøyet ditt på den siden av veien der skiltet gjelder. Det er heller ikke tillatt å stanse for av- og påstigning eller av- og lessing.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 217 — "No parking". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You are not allowed to park your vehicle on this side of the road. Quick loading, unloading, or passenger drop-off is permitted.
meaning.nb: Du har ikke lov til å parkere kjøretøyet ditt på denne siden av veien. Hurtig av- og pålessing eller av- og påstigning er tillatt.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 217 — "Parking zone". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign marks the start of an area where parking is permitted subject to specific regulations indicated on the sign. You must follow the time limits and conditions specified for the zone.
meaning.nb: Skiltet angir begynnelse på et område hvor parkering er tillatt i henhold til nærmere angitte bestemmelser på skiltet. Du må følge tidsbegrensningene og vilkårene som gjelder for sonen.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 218 — "Parking zone". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You are entering an area where parking is prohibited within the specified times. The prohibition applies to the entire zone until you pass a sign indicating the end of the zone.
meaning.nb: Du kjører inn i et område der parkering er forbudt i de angitte tidsrommene. Forbudet gjelder for hele sonen til du passerer et skilt som angir at sonen opphører.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 218 — "End of parking zone". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign marks the end of a parking zone. The regulations that applied within the zone no longer apply.
meaning.nb: Skiltet markerer slutten på en parkeringssone. Bestemmelsene som gjaldt innenfor sonen, gjelder ikke lenger.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 219 — "End of parking zone". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that the parking zone is ending. The regulations that applied within the zone no longer apply.
meaning.nb: Dette skiltet angir at soneparkeringen opphører. Bestemmelsene som gjaldt innenfor sonen, gjelder ikke lenger.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 219 — "Mandatory driving direction — proceed right". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You must pass to the right of the sign. You are required to follow the direction indicated by the arrow.
meaning.nb: Du må passere til høyre for skiltet. Du er pålagt å følge kjøreretningen som pilen angir.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 220 — "Mandatory driving direction — proceed left". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You must pass the sign and proceed to the left.
meaning.nb: Du må passere skiltet og fortsette til venstre.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 220 — "Mandatory driving direction — proceed straight". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You must drive straight ahead. Turning left or right is prohibited.
meaning.nb: Du må kjøre rett fram. Det er forbudt å svinge til venstre eller høyre.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 221 — "Mandatory driving direction — turn right". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You must turn right. The sign instructs you to follow the mandatory direction indicated by the arrow.
meaning.nb: Du må svinge til høyre. Skiltet påbyr deg å følge den angitte kjøreretningen som pilen viser.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 221 — "Mandatory driving direction — turn left". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You must turn left. The sign instructs you to follow the mandatory direction indicated by the arrow.
meaning.nb: Du må svinge til venstre. Skiltet pålegger deg å følge den angitte kjøreretningen.

name.en: Mandatory driving direction — drive straight or turn right
name.nb: Påbudt kjøreretning — rett fram eller sving til høyre

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 222 — "Mandatory driving direction — drive straight or turn right". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You must drive either straight ahead or turn right at the upcoming junction. Other directions are prohibited.
meaning.nb: Du må enten kjøre rett fram eller svinge til høyre i den kommende vegkryssingen. Andre kjøreretninger er ikke tillatt.

name.en: Mandatory driving direction — drive straight or turn left
name.nb: Påbudt kjøreretning — rett fram eller sving til venstre

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 222 — "Mandatory driving direction — drive straight or turn left". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You must drive either straight ahead or turn left at the intersection. Other directions are prohibited.
meaning.nb: Du må enten kjøre rett fram eller svinge til venstre i krysset. Andre kjøreretninger er forbudt.

name.en: Mandatory driving direction — turn right or left
name.nb: Påbudt kjøreretning – sving til høyre eller venstre

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 223 — "Mandatory driving direction — turn right or left". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You must turn either right or left at the intersection ahead. Driving straight ahead is not permitted.
meaning.nb: Du må svinge enten til høyre eller venstre i krysset lenger framme. Det er ikke tillatt å kjøre rett fram.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 223 — "Mandatory lane — pass on the right". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You must pass on the side indicated by the arrow.
meaning.nb: Du må passere på den siden som pilen viser.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 224 — "Mandatory lane — pass on the left". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You must pass the sign or the obstacle on the left side.
meaning.nb: Du må passere skiltet eller hindringen på venstre side.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 224 — "Mandatory roundabout". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You must drive in the direction indicated by the arrows around the central island. You must also yield the right-of-way to traffic already in the roundabout.
meaning.nb: Du må kjøre i den retningen pilene rundt midtøya viser. Du må også vike for kjørende som allerede er i rundkjøringen.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 225 — "Motorway". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates the start of a motorway. General traffic rules for motorways apply from this point.
meaning.nb: Skiltet angir begynnelse på motorveg. Spesielle trafikkleregler for motorveg gjelder fra dette punktet.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 225 — "Semi-motorway / Road for motor vehicles". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You are entering a road intended for motor vehicles only. Pedestrians, cyclists, and vehicles not capable of reaching the minimum speed limit are prohibited.
meaning.nb: Du kjører inn på en veg som bare er for motorvogner. Gående, syklende og kjøretøy som ikke kan oppnå en viss minstefart, er forbudt.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 226 — "End of motorway". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that the motorway ends and special motorway regulations no longer apply. General traffic rules for ordinary roads now apply.
meaning.nb: Skiltet angir at motorvegen slutter og at de spesielle motorvegreglene ikke lenger gjelder. De alminnelige trafikkreglene for vanlige veger gjelder nå.

name.en: End of road for motor vehicles

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 226 — "End of semi-motorway / End of road for motor vehicles". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that the road for motor vehicles ends. General traffic regulations apply again after this sign.
meaning.nb: Skiltet angir at motortrafikkveien tar slutt. Alminnelige trafikkregler gjelder igjen etter dette skiltet.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 227 — "Public transport lane — bus lane". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This lane is reserved for buses and other designated vehicles. You must not drive in this lane unless specified otherwise by supplementary signs.
meaning.nb: Dette feltet er reservert for buss og andre angitte kjøretøy. Du kan ikke kjøre i dette feltet med mindre underskilt angir noe annet.

name.en: Public transport lane — bus and taxi lane

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 227 — "Public transport lane — bus and taxi lane". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This lane is reserved for buses and taxis. You must not drive in this lane with a regular passenger car unless permitted by additional signs.
meaning.nb: Dette feltet er reservert for buss og drosje. Du kan ikke kjøre i dette feltet med en vanlig personbil med mindre tilleggsskilt tillater det.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 228 — "High-occupancy vehicle lane". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This lane is reserved for vehicles carrying the specified minimum number of people. You may only use this lane if your vehicle meets the occupant requirement.
meaning.nb: Dette feltet er forbeholdt kjøretøy med et spesifisert minimum antall personer. Du kan bare bruke dette feltet dersom kjøretøyet ditt oppfyller personkravet.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 228 — "End of public transport lane". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that the public transport lane ends. You must merge into the ordinary traffic lanes.
meaning.nb: Skiltet angir at kollektivfeltet slutter. Du må flette inn i de vanlige kjørefeltene.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 229 — "End of public transport lane". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that the public transport lane or bus lane ends. You must merge into the ordinary traffic lanes.
meaning.nb: Skiltet angir at kollektivfeltet eller bussfeltet slutter. Du må flette inn i de vanlige kjørefeltene.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 229 — "End of high-occupancy vehicle lane". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that the high-occupancy vehicle lane ends. You must follow the general traffic rules and lane markings that apply from this point.
meaning.nb: Skiltet angir at sambruksfeltet slutter. Du må rette deg etter de generelle trafikkreglene og oppmerkingen som gjelder fra dette punktet.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 230 — "Bus stop". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign marks a designated stopping place for buses. You must not park your vehicle here.
meaning.nb: Dette skiltet markerer en fastsatt holdeplass for buss. Du har ikke lov til å parkere kjøretøyet ditt her.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 230 — "Tram stop". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates a designated stop for trams. You must be aware of pedestrians crossing the road to or from the tram.
meaning.nb: Skiltet angir en fastsatt holdeplass for trikk. Du må være oppmerksom på gående som krysser veien til eller fra trikken.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 230 — "Taxi stop". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This area is reserved for taxis. You must not park or stop other vehicles here, except for brief loading or unloading of passengers if it does not hinder taxis.
meaning.nb: Dette området er reservert for drosjer. Du kan ikke parkere eller stoppe andre kjøretøy her, unntatt ved kort av- eller påstigning for passasjerer dersom det ikke er til hinder for drosjer.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 231 — "Pedestrian crossing". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign marks a pedestrian crossing. You must yield to pedestrians who are on or about to enter the crossing.
meaning.nb: Skiltet angir et gangfelt. Du har vikeplikt for gående som befinner seg i eller er på vei inn i gangfeltet.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 231 — "Footpath". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates a path intended for pedestrians. Driving with a motor vehicle on this path is prohibited.
meaning.nb: Skiltet angir veg som er ment for gående. Kjøring med motorvogn på vegen er forbudt.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 232 — "Cycle track". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates a track intended for cyclists. As a car driver, you are not permitted to drive on this track.
meaning.nb: Skiltet viser en veg som er beregnet for syklende. Som bilfører har du ikke lov til å kjøre på denne vegen.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 232 — "Cycle lane". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates a lane reserved for cyclists. You are not allowed to drive your motor vehicle in this lane.
meaning.nb: Skiltet angir felt som er reservert for syklende. Du har ikke lov til å kjøre motorvognen din i dette feltet.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 233 — "Footpath and cycle track". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates a combined track designated for pedestrians and cyclists. Motor vehicles are not permitted to use this track.
meaning.nb: Skiltet angir en felles veg som er beregnet for gående og syklende. Motorvogner har ikke tillatelse til å benytte vegen.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 233 — "Meeting/passing place". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates a designated area on narrow roads intended to facilitate the passing of oncoming vehicles. You can use it to stop or pull over to let other traffic pass.
meaning.nb: Skiltet viser en merket utvidelse på smale veier som gjør det enklere å møte og passere motgående kjøretøy. Du kan bruke den til å stoppe eller svinge til siden for å slippe fram annen trafikk.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 234 — "One-way traffic". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that traffic only moves in the direction indicated by the arrow. You must not drive in the opposite direction.
meaning.nb: Skiltet angir at trafikken bare går i den retningen pilen viser. Du har ikke lov til å kjøre i motsatt retning.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 234 — "One-way traffic". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that traffic on the road moves only in the direction shown by the arrow. You must not drive in the opposite direction.
meaning.nb: Skiltet angir at trafikken på veien bare går i den retningen pilen viser. Du kan ikke kjøre i motsetning til pilens retning.

name.en: No through road on side road

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 235 — "No through road / Dead end". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that the side road you are approaching is a dead end. You cannot continue through this road.
meaning.nb: Skiltet varsler at sidevegen du svinger inn på, er en blindveg. Du kan ikke kjøre igjennom denne vegen.

name.en: No through road for cycles and mopeds

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 235 — "No through road / Dead end". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that the road ahead is a dead end for cycles and mopeds. You will not be able to continue through to another road.
meaning.nb: Skiltet angir at veien er blindvei for syklere og mopedister. Du vil ikke kunne fortsette videre til en annen vei.

name.en: No through road for motor vehicles, with through connection for cyclists
name.nb: Blindvei for motorvogn, med gjennomgående forbindelse for syklende

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 236 — "No through road / Dead end". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that the road ahead is a dead end for motor vehicles, but has a through connection for cyclists.
meaning.nb: Skiltet viser at veien foran er blindvei for motorvogner, men har gjennomgående forbindelse for syklende.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 236 — "Free choice of lane". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You may pass on either side of the obstacle or traffic island indicated by the arrows.
meaning.nb: Du kan passere på valgfri side av hindringen eller trafikkskillet som pilene viser.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 237 — "Merging lanes". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that separate traffic lanes are merging into a single lane ahead. You must adapt your speed and position to smoothly integrate with other traffic.
meaning.nb: Skiltet varsler om at separate kjørefelt flettes sammen til ett felt lenger fremme. Du må tilpasse fart og plassering for å samhandle smidig med annen trafikk.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 237 — "Acceleration lane". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates an acceleration lane on a multi-lane road where traffic from an on-ramp merges into the through traffic. You must adjust your speed and position to merge safely with the ongoing traffic.
meaning.nb: Skiltet viser et felt for kjøring inn på en veg med flere felt, der trafikk fra en påkjøringsveg flettes inn i gjennomfarten. Du må tilpasse hastighet og plassering for å flette deg trygt inn i trafikken.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 238 — "Acceleration lane". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates an acceleration lane where traffic from another road joins your route. You must match your speed to the traffic on the main road before merging.
meaning.nb: Skiltet viser et felt der trafikk fra en annen vei flettes inn på din veg. Du må tilpasse farten etter trafikken på hovedveien før du skifter felt.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 238 — "End of lane". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that the lane you are in is ending and you must merge into the adjacent lane.
meaning.nb: Skiltet angir at kjørefeltet du befinner deg i tar slutt, og du må flette inn i det tilstøtende feltet.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 239 — "Lane begins". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that a new traffic lane begins. You can use the new lane according to the lane markings.
meaning.nb: Skiltet viser at det begynner et nytt kjørefelt. Du kan ta i bruk det nye feltet i tråd met oppmerkingen.

name.en: Traffic joins road in separate lane
name.nb: Trafikk til slutter seg i eget felt

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 239 — "Traffic joins road in separate lane". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that traffic from another road joins your road in a separate lane, meaning you do not need to yield to entering traffic, but you should be aware of vehicles merging alongside you.
meaning.nb: Skiltet viser at trafikk fra en annen vei føyer seg inn på veien din i et eget felt. Du har ikke vikeplikt for denne trafikken, men du må være oppmerksom på kjøretøy som fletter inn ved siden av deg.

name.en: Traffic joins road in separate lane
name.nb: Trafikk slutter seg til veien i eget felt

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 240 — "Traffic joins road in separate lane". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that traffic from another road enters in a separate lane alongside yours. You are not required to yield to the entering traffic unless other rules apply.
meaning.nb: Skiltet viser at trafikk fra en annen vei kommer inn i et eget felt ved siden av ditt. Du har ikke vikeplikt for trafikken som kommer inn, med mindre andre regler gjelder.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 240 — "Lane division". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign shows the number of lanes available and how they are allocated for traffic direction. You must follow the direction indicated for the lane you are using.
meaning.nb: Skiltet viser antall kjørefelt og hvordan de er fordelt på kjøreretninger. Du må følge retningen som er angitt for feltet du bruker.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 241 — "Altered driving pattern". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that the traffic lanes have been temporarily or permanently altered. You must pay attention to the new lane configuration and follow the indicated path.
meaning.nb: Skiltet viser at kjørefeltene er midlertidig eller permanent endret. Du må være oppmerksom på den nye feltinndelingen og følge den angitte kjørebanen.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 241 — "Pedestrianised residential street / Living street". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You are entering a zone where pedestrians have priority and vehicle traffic is subject to special restrictions. You must drive at walking speed and give way to pedestrians.
meaning.nb: Du kjører inn i en sone der gående har forkjørsrett og kjøretøytrafikken er underlagt spesielle restriksjoner. Du må kjøre i gangfart og vike for gående.

name.en: End of pedestrianised residential street zone

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 242 — "End of pedestrianised residential street / living street". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign marks the end of a living street zone. General traffic rules and speed limits again apply after this sign.
meaning.nb: Skiltet angir slutten på en gågate- og boligsonesone. Generelle trafikkskjemaer og fartsgrenser gjelder igjen etter dette skiltet.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 242 — "Pedestrian street". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You are entering a zone where the rules for pedestrian streets apply. Driving motor vehicles is prohibited unless otherwise indicated.
meaning.nb: Du kjører inn i en sone der reglene for gågate gjelder. Kjøring med motorvogn er forbudt med mindre annet er angitt.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 243 — "End of pedestrian street". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign marks the end of a pedestrian street zone. The special traffic regulations for the pedestrian zone no longer apply.
meaning.nb: Skiltet angir slutten på en gågatesone. De spesielle trafikkreglene for gågaten gjelder ikke lenger fra dette punktet.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 243 — "Parking". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that parking is permitted in the designated area. You may park your vehicle here in accordance with any accompanying supplementary panels.
meaning.nb: Skiltet angir at parkering er tillatt på det markerte området. Du kan parkere kjøretøyet ditt her i samsvar med eventuelle underskilt.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 244 — "Automatic speed control". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that the road section is monitored by an automatic speed camera. You must maintain a correct and legal speed.
meaning.nb: Skiltet varsler om at veistrekningen blir overvåket av et automatisk trafikkontrollutstyr. Du må opprettholde en riktig og lovlig fart.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 244 — "Automatic speed section control". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You are entering a road section where your average speed is automatically measured between two points. You must maintain a legal speed throughout the entire measured zone.
meaning.nb: Du kjører inn på en veistrekning der gjennomsnittsfarten din blir automatisk målt mellom to punkter. Du må holde fartsgrensen gjennom hele den målte strekningen.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 245 — "Video surveillance". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign informs you that the area is subject to video surveillance.
meaning.nb: Skiltet opplyser om at området er gjenstand for videoovervåking.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 245 — "Information board". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign informs you that there is a toll plaza ahead at the specified distance. You must be prepared to pay a toll.
meaning.nb: Skiltet informerer om at det kommer en bomstasjon på den angitte avstanden. Du må være forberedt på å betale bompenger.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 246 — "Wrong way". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You must stop and turn your vehicle around.
meaning.nb: Du må stoppe og snu kjøretøyet.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 246 — "Emergency exit (for tunnels)". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates an emergency exit you can use to leave the tunnel in an emergency. It shows the location of a safe exit route.
meaning.nb: Skiltet viser en nødutgang du kan bruke til å forlate tunellen i en nødsituasjon. Det viser plasseringen av en trygg rømningsvei.

name.en: Direction and distance to emergency exit (for tunnels)

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 246 — "Direction and distance to emergency exit (for tunnels)". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates the direction and remaining distance to the nearest emergency exit in a tunnel.
meaning.nb: Dette skiltet viser retning og gjenværende avstand til nærmeste nødutgang i en tunnel.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 247 — "Radio channel". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign informs you about the radio frequency for traffic information on the upcoming road stretch.
meaning.nb: Skiltet opplyser om radiokanal og frekvens for trafikkinformasjon på den kommende strekningen.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 247 — "First aid". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates the location of a first-aid post or facility.
meaning.nb: Skiltet viser hvor det finnes et førstehjelpssted eller en førstehjelpsfasilitet.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 248 — "Emergency telephone". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that you can find an emergency telephone at this location.
meaning.nb: Dette skiltet viser at du finner en nødtelefon på dette stedet.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 248 — "Fire extinguisher". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates the location of a fire extinguisher. You can use it in case of a vehicle or road fire.
meaning.nb: Dette skiltet viser hvor det finnes et brannapparat. Du kan bruke det i tilfelle det oppstår brann i kjøretøyet eller på veien.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 249 — "Workshop". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign informs you that there is a vehicle repair shop available nearby.
meaning.nb: Skiltet informerer om at det finnes et bilverksted i nærheten.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 249 — "Petrol station". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign informs you that there is a petrol station ahead where you can refuel your vehicle.
meaning.nb: Skiltet informerer om at det er en bensinstasjon lenger fremme hvor du kan fylle drivstoff på kjøretøyet.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 250 — "Toilet emptying facility". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign informs you that there is a facility nearby for emptying chemical toilets from motorhomes and caravans.
meaning.nb: Skiltet informerer om at det finnes en anordning i nærheten for tømming av kjemikalietoaletter fra bobiler og campingvogner.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 250 — "Toilet". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign informs you that there is a public toilet available nearby.
meaning.nb: Dette skiltet informerer deg om at det er et offentlig toalett i nærheten.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 251 — "Rest stop". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that there is a rest stop ahead where you can park and take a break. The area is typically equipped with facilities such as tables and benches.
meaning.nb: Skiltet viser at det er en rasteplass lenger fremme hvor du kan parkere og ta en pause. Området er vanligvis utstyrt med fasiliteter som bord og benker.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 251 — "Rest stop with toilet". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign informs you that there is a rest area ahead equipped with toilet facilities. You can use this location to stop, rest, and use the restroom.
meaning.nb: Skiltet informerer om at det er en rasteplass lenger fremme som er utstyrt med toalettmuligheter. Du kan benytte dette stedet til å stoppe, hvile og benytte toalettet.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 252 — "Simple dining". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign informs you that there is a café, kiosk or similar establishment offering simple refreshments nearby.
meaning.nb: Skiltet informerer deg om at det finnes en kafé, kiosk eller lignende som tilbyr enklere servering i nærheten.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 252 — "Dining". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that there is a restaurant or dining facility nearby.
meaning.nb: Skiltet viser at det er restaurant eller serveringssted i nærheten.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 253 — "Camp site". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that there is a camp site nearby.
meaning.nb: Skiltet varsler om at det finnes en campingplass i nærheten.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 253 — "Motor home site / Caravan park". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates a designated parking area specifically for motor homes.
meaning.nb: Skiltet viser en tilrettelagt parkeringsplass spesielt for biler i kjøretøyklassen bobil.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 254 — "Camping park". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign informs you that there is a youth hostel nearby.
meaning.nb: Skiltet informerer om at det er et vandrehjem i nærheten.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 254 — "Hostel". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign informs you that there is a youth hostel nearby.
meaning.nb: Skiltet informerer deg om at det er et vandrehjem i nærheten.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 255 — "Overnight accommodation". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign informs you that there is a hotel, motel, or other overnight accommodation nearby.
meaning.nb: Dette skiltet informerer deg om at det finnes et hotell, motell eller annen overnattingsmulighet i nærheten.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 255 — "Information". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that general information about road conditions, services, or local areas is available.
meaning.nb: Skiltet viser at det finnes generell informasjon om trafikkforhold, tjenester eller lokalt område.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 256 — "Tourist information office". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign informs you that there is a tourist information office ahead where you can get information, maps, and guidance about local attractions.
meaning.nb: Skiltet informerer om at det finnes et turistinformasjonskontor i nærheten der du kan få informasjon, kart og veiledning om lokale attraksjoner.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 256 — "Attraction". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign informs you that you are approaching an attraction, a place of interest, or a cultural and natural heritage site.
meaning.nb: Skiltet informerer om at du nærmer deg en severdighet, et interessant sted eller et kultur- og naturminne.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 257 — "Museum / Art gallery". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that there is a museum or art gallery nearby.
meaning.nb: Skiltet viser at det er et museum eller kunstgalleri i nærheten.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 257 — "Viewpoint". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign informs you that there is a viewpoint nearby, where you can stop to enjoy the scenery.
meaning.nb: Skiltet informerer om at det er et utsiktspunkt i nærheten, hvor du kan stoppe for å nyte landskapet.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 258 — "Protected natural area". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign informs you that you are entering a protected natural area. You must respect the specific environmental regulations and restrictions that apply within the area.
meaning.nb: Skiltet informerer om at du kjører inn i et vernet område. Du må overholde de spesifikke miljøreglene og restriksjonene som gjelder i området.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 258 — "Bathing spot". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign informs you that there is a bathing spot nearby.
meaning.nb: Skiltet informerer om at det er en badeplass i nærheten.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 259 — "Fishing area". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign informs you that you are approaching or have arrived at a designated fishing area.
meaning.nb: Skiltet informerer om at du nærmer deg eller har kommet til et egnet område for fiske.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 259 — "Hiking trail". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates the start or location of a hiking trail.
meaning.nb: Dette skiltet viser starten på eller beliggenheten til en tursti.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 260 — "Ski trail". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that there is a ski trail or starting point for skiing nearby.
meaning.nb: Skiltet viser at det er en skiløype eller et utgangspunkt for skiturer i nærheten.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 260 — "Traditional food and rural tourism". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that you can find traditional food and rural tourism services nearby.
meaning.nb: Skiltet viser at du kan finne tradisjonsmat og tilbud innen bygdeturisme i nærheten.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 261 — "Orientation board". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign informs you about destinations and route choices ahead at intersections or junctions. It helps you position your vehicle in the correct lane in good time.
meaning.nb: Dette skiltet informerer deg om reisemål og rutevalg lenger framme ved vegkryss. Det hjelper deg med å plassere kjøretøyet i riktig kjørefelt i god tid.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 261 — "Diagram orientation board". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign gives you a diagrammatic overview of the road layout ahead, showing routes, destinations, and traffic regulations for upcoming junctions.
meaning.nb: Skiltet gir deg en skjematisk oversikt over vegforholdene lenger frem, og viser ruter, reisemål og trafikkreguleringer for kommende kryss.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 261 — "Exit board". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign informs you about upcoming exits, route numbers, and destinations on major roads. Prepare to position your vehicle in the correct lane for your intended route.
meaning.nb: Skiltet informerer om kommende avkjøringer, vegnummer og reisemål på hovedveger. Forbered deg på å plassere kjøretøyet i riktig felt for din tiltenkte rute.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 261 — "Lane orientation board". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign shows you which lane to choose for your destination and gives an overview of upcoming route choices and destinations.
meaning.nb: Skiltet viser deg hvilket kjørefelt du bør velge for din destinasjon, og gir en oversikt over kommende rutevalg og reisemål.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 262 — "Portal orientation board". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign provides advance information about destinations and lane allocation ahead of an intersection or junction. You must position your vehicle in the correct lane in good time according to your intended destination.
meaning.nb: Skiltet gir forhåndsorientering om kjøreruter og kjørefeltvalg foran et kryss. Du må plassere kjøretøyet i riktig felt i god tid i samsvar med ditt reisemål.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 262 — "Board guide". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign gives you an overview of destinations, routes and directions at the upcoming intersection or junction.
meaning.nb: Skiltet gir deg oversikt over reisemål, veier og kjøreretninger i det kommende krysset.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 262 — "Regular destination guide". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign informs you about destinations, road numbers, and the direction you need to follow along your route. It helps you navigate toward specific towns, areas, or facilities.
meaning.nb: Dette skiltet informerer deg om reisemål, vegnummer og retningen du må følge langs ruten din. Det hjelper deg med å navigere mot spesifikke steder, områder eller fasiliteter.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 263 — "Exit guide". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates the direction and destinations for an upcoming exit. You can use it to prepare for changing lanes and leaving the road.
meaning.nb: Skiltet viser retning og reisemål for en kommende avkjøring. Du kan bruke det til å forberede kjørefeltbytte og avrenning fra veien.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 263 — "Lane guide". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign shows you which lane to choose for your destination and indicates the permitted directions in the respective lanes. You must select the correct lane in good time.
meaning.nb: Dette skiltet viser deg hvilket kjørefelt du skal velge til din destinasjon, og angir tillatte kjøreretninger i de ulike feltene. Du må plassere deg i riktig felt i god tid.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 263 — "Portal guide". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign shows destinations and route choices for individual traffic lanes, mounted on a portal above the roadway. You should use the information to choose the correct lane for your destination in good time.
meaning.nb: Skiltet viser kjøreruter og mål for de enkelte kjørefeltene, og er plassert på en tverrbjelke over veien. Du bør bruke informasjonen til å velge riktig kjørefelt i god tid før du skal svinge av.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 263 — "European route". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that the road is part of the international European route network. Follow this designation for navigation along major transnational corridors.
meaning.nb: Skiltet viser at veien er en del av det internasjonale europaveinettet. Følg denne betegnelsen for navigasjon langs større transnasjonale korridorer.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 264 — "European route". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that the road is part of the international European route network. You can follow these markers for long-distance navigation.
meaning.nb: Dette skiltet viser at veien er en del av det internasjonale europaveinettet. Du kan følge disse merkene for langdistansenavigasjon.
