name.en: National road that is not a European route

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 264 — "National road that is not a European route". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates a national road that is not a European route. You are driving on a numbered national road.
meaning.nb: Skiltet viser en riksveg som ikke er europaveg. Du kjører på en nummerert riksveg.

name.en: National road that is not a European route

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 265 — "National road that is not a European route". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates a national road that is part of the national road network but is not designated as a European route. You can use it for navigation along national roads.
meaning.nb: Dette skiltet viser en riksveg som er en del av riksvegnettet, men som ikke er klassifisert som europaveg. Du kan bruke det til navigering langs riksveger.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 265 — "Numbered county road". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that you are driving on a numbered county road. Use the number to navigate and orient yourself using a map or GPS.
meaning.nb: Skiltet viser at du kjører på en fylkesveg med nummer. Bruk nummeret til å navigere og orientere deg ved hjelp av kart eller GPS.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 265 — "Numbered county road". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that you are driving on a numbered county road. The number helps you navigate and match your route with a map.
meaning.nb: Skiltet viser at du kjører på en nummerert fylkesveg. Nummeret hjelper deg med å navigere og finne frem i henhold til et kart.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 266 — "Ring road". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates a designated ring road for through traffic around a city or urban area. You can follow this route to navigate around the center.
meaning.nb: Skiltet viser en fastsatt ringvei for gjennomgangstrafikk rundt en by eller et tettsted. Du kan følge denne ruten for å lede trafikken utenom sentrumsområdet.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 266 — "Ring road". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign guides you along a designated ring road around a city or urban area.
meaning.nb: Dette skiltet viser vei langs en fastsatt ringvei rundt en by eller et tettsted.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 266 — "National tourist road". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that you are driving on a designated national tourist road, which runs through areas with particularly scenic nature and culture.
meaning.nb: Skiltet viser at du kjører på en offisiell nasjonal turistveg, som går gjennom områder med særlig god natur og kultur.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 267 — "Detour for large vehicles". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates a temporary detour route specifically designated for large vehicles. You must follow this route if you are driving a vehicle that falls under this category.
meaning.nb: Skiltet viser en midlertidig omkjøringsrute som er spesielt beregnet for store kjøretøy. Du må følge denne ruten hvis du kjører et kjøretøy som omfattes av denne kategorien.

name.en: Route for vehicles transporting dangerous goods
name.nb: Anbefalt veg for kjøretøy med farlig gods

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 267 — "Route for vehicles transporting dangerous goods". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates a recommended route for vehicles transporting dangerous goods. If you drive such a vehicle, you should follow this route.
meaning.nb: Skiltet viser anbefalt veg for kjøretøy som transporterer farlig gods. Kjører du et slikt kjøretøy, bør du følge denne vegen.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 268 — "Miscellaneous detour". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This symbol is used in combination with other temporary routing signs to indicate a specific detour route. You must follow the direction indicated by the sign system.
meaning.nb: Dette symbolet brukes sammen med andre midlertidige visningsskilt for å angi en bestemt omkjøringsrute. Du må følge retningen som angis av skiltet.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 268 — "Miscellaneous detour". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This symbol is used on detour routes to guide you along a temporary path. Follow signs featuring this symbol to navigate past a blocked section.
meaning.nb: Dette symbolet brukes på omkjøringsruter for å lede deg langs en midlertidig vei. Følg skilt med dette symbolet for å navigere forbi en stengt veistrekning.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 269 — "Miscellaneous detour". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This symbol is used on temporary route signs to guide you along a detour. You must follow the direction indicated by the temporary route system.
meaning.nb: Dette symbolet brukes på skilt for midlertidig omkjøringsrute for å lede deg langs en omvei. Du må følge retningen som angis av omkjøringssystemet.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 269 — "Miscellaneous detour". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates a temporary detour route that you can follow. You must follow the direction indicated by the detour marking.
meaning.nb: Skiltet viser en midlertidig omkjøringsrute som du kan følge. Du må følge den retningen som omkjøringsmerkingen angir.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 270 — "Miscellaneous detour". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates a specific detour route for traffic, marked by a specific symbol. You can follow this symbol to navigate through the temporary detour.
meaning.nb: Dette skiltet viser en bestemt omkjøringsrute for trafikk, merket med et spesifikt symbol. Du kan følge dette symbolet for å navigere gjennom den midlertidige omkjøringen.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 270 — "Miscellaneous detour". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates a temporary detour along a different route due to roadwork or obstacles ahead. You must follow the direction shown by the arrow.
meaning.nb: Skiltet viser en midlertidig omkjøring langs en annen rute på grunn av veiarbeid eller hindringer lenger fremme. Du må følge retningen som vises av pilen.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 270 — "Junction number on multilane roads". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates the number of the upcoming junction or exit on a multilane road. You can use this number to orient yourself and easily locate your exit.
meaning.nb: Dette skiltet viser nummeret på den kommende avkjøringen på flerfeltsvei. Du kan bruke dette nummeret til å orientere deg og enklere finne frem til din avkjøring.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 271 — "Junction number on multilane roads". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates the number of the upcoming junction or exit on a multilane road. You can use this number to navigate and confirm your position along the route.
meaning.nb: Skiltet viser nummeret på den kommende avkjørselen eller vegknutepunktet på veg med flere felt. Du kan bruke nummeret til å orientere deg og bekrefte posisjonen din langs ruten.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 271 — "Junction number on two-lane roads". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates the number of the upcoming junction or exit. You can use the number to orient yourself and find the correct exit along your route.
meaning.nb: Skiltet viser nummeret på den kommende avkjøringen. Du kan bruke nummeret til å orientere deg og finne riktig avkjøring langs ruten din.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 271 — "Region name sign". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign informs you that you are entering a specific municipality or region. It serves as an orientation guide along your route.
meaning.nb: Dette skiltet informerer deg om at du kjører inn i en bestemt kommune eller region. Det fungerer som en orienteringstavle langs ruten din.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 271 — "Street sign". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign shows the name of the street or road you are on or approaching.
meaning.nb: Dette skiltet viser navnet på gaten eller veien du befinner deg på eller svinger inn på.

name.en: Collective guide sign for industrial area

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 272 — "Collective guide sign". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign informs you about destinations and services available within an industrial or business area.
meaning.nb: Skiltet orienterer om reisemål og virksomheter som finnes innenfor et industri- eller næringsområde.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 272 — "Detour for certain vehicles". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates a detour for specific vehicles, such as heavy goods vehicles, due to restrictions ahead. You must follow the designated detour route if your vehicle matches the category shown.
meaning.nb: Skiltet viser omkjøring for bestemte kjøretøy, for eksempel tyngre kjøretøy, på grunn av restriksjoner lenger fremme. Du må følge den angitte omkjøringsveien hvis kjøretøyet ditt faller inn under den viste kategorien.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 273 — "Temporary detour". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates a temporary detour ahead due to roadwork or obstacles. You must follow the indicated route to bypass the closed road section.
meaning.nb: Skiltet viser at det er en midlertidig omkjøring lenger fremme på grunn av vegarbeid eller hindringer. Du må følge den angitte ruten for å kjøre utenfor det stengte veipartiet.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 273 — "End of temporary detour". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that the temporary detour route has ended and you are back on the regular route.
meaning.nb: Skiltet angir at den midlertidige omkjøringsruten er avsluttet, og at du er tilbake på den ordinære ruten.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 273 — "Guide for pedestrians". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates the direction and distance to a destination specifically for pedestrians. It is used along walking routes to guide pedestrians toward a named location.
meaning.nb: Skiltet viser retning og avstand til et reisemål spesielt for gående. Det brukes langs gangveier og stier for å veilede gående mot et angitt sted.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 274 — "Guide for bicycle route". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign informs cyclists about the direction, route number, destination, and distance along a bicycle route.
meaning.nb: Skiltet gir syklister opplysninger om retning, vegnummer, reisemål og avstand langs en sykkelveg.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 274 — "Board guide for bicycle route". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign informs you about destinations and distances along a bicycle route. It may also show route numbers and directions.
meaning.nb: Dette skiltet opplyser om reisemål og avstander langs en sykkelrute. Det kan også vise rutenummer og retninger.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 274 — "Bicycle route". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates a national or regional bicycle route. It helps cyclists navigate along designated paths and roads.
meaning.nb: Skiltet viser nasjonal eller regional sykkelrute. Det hjelper syklister med å finne frem langs oppmerkede veier og stier.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 275 — "Distance sign for bicycle route". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign informs you about the distance in kilometers to destinations along a national or regional bicycle route.
meaning.nb: Skiltet informerer deg om avstanden i kilometer til ulike steder langs en nasjonal eller regional sykkelrute.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 275 — "Motorway". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that you are entering a motorway. General rules and regulations for motorways apply from this point.
meaning.nb: Skiltet angir at du kjører inn på en motorveg. Generelle trafikkregler for motorveg gjelder fra dette punktet.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 276 — "Semi-motorway / Road for motor vehicles". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You are driving on a road reserved for motor vehicles where specific traffic regulations apply, such as a prohibition against pedestrians, cyclists, and slow-moving vehicles.
meaning.nb: Du kjører på en veg for motorvogner hvor det gjelder spesifikke trafikktreffregler, som forbud mot gående, syklende og langsomtgående kjøretøy.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 276 — "Toll road". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that you are entering a road where a toll is charged. You must be prepared to pay according to current regulations.
meaning.nb: Skiltet angir at du kjører inn på en veg hvor det kreves inn avgift. Du må være forberedt på å betale i henhold til gjeldende bestemmelser.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 277 — "Parking". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that parking is permitted. You must follow any additional instructions on supplementary plates regarding time limits or payment.
meaning.nb: Dette skiltet viser at parkering er tillatt. Du må følge eventuelle tilleggstavler som gjelder tidsbegrensning eller betaling.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 277 — "Parking garage". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that there is a parking garage available in the direction shown.
meaning.nb: Skiltet viser at det finnes et parkeringshus i den angitte retningen.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 278 — "Airport". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates the route to an airport.
meaning.nb: Skiltet viser kjøreruten til en lufthavn.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 278 — "Helipad". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates a helipad or a route leading to a helipad.
meaning.nb: Skiltet viser vei til en helikopterplass.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 279 — "Bus station/terminal". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates a bus station or terminal where buses assemble or depart. You should be aware of increased bus traffic in the area.
meaning.nb: Skiltet angir busstasjon eller terminal der busser samles eller har avgang. Du må være oppmerksom på økt busstrafikk i området.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 279 — "Train station/terminal". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign informs you that you are approaching or at a train station or terminal.
meaning.nb: Dette skiltet informerer deg om at du nærmer deg eller er ved en togstasjon eller jernbaneterminal.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 280 — "Ferry". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates the route to a ferry connection. Follow the directions to reach the ferry terminal.
meaning.nb: Skiltet viser veien til en ferjesamband. Følg anvisningene for å komme frem til ferjekai.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 280 — "Chains". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that snow chains are recommended for better traction.
meaning.nb: Dette skiltet angir at det anbefales å bruke snøkjettinger for å få bedre veigrep.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 281 — "Church". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates the location of a church.
meaning.nb: Dette skiltet viser beliggenheten til en kirke.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 281 — "Industrial area". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates an industrial area or commercial zone ahead. You can expect heavy traffic, trucks, and varying speed limits or traffic patterns.
meaning.nb: Skiltet viser vei til et industriområde eller næringsområde. Du må være oppmerksom på tungtrafikk, lastebiler og mulige endringer i trafikkbildet.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 282 — "Swimming hall". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign informs you that there is a swimming hall nearby.
meaning.nb: Skiltet informerer om at det er en svømmehall i nærheten.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 282 — "Alpine facility". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign informs you that there is an alpine facility nearby.
meaning.nb: Skiltet informerer om at det er et alpinanlegg i nærheten.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 283 — "Ski jumping hill". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates the direction to a ski jumping hill or facility. You can use it to orient yourself toward the recreational area.
meaning.nb: Dette skiltet viser retningen til en hoppbakke eller et hoppsenter. Du kan bruke det til å orientere deg mot anlegget.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 283 — "Ski arena". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates the direction to a nearby ski arena or winter sports facility. You can use it to navigate toward the specified destination.
meaning.nb: Skiltet viser retningen til en nærliggende skiarena eller et vintersportssenter. Du kan bruke det til å finne frem til det oppgitte reisemålet.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 284 — "Payment with electronic toll tag". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that you can pay with an electronic toll tag. It is used in combination with other signs at toll stations.
meaning.nb: Skiltet angir at du kan betale med elektronisk brikke. Det brukes i kombinasjon med andre skilt ved bomstasjoner.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 284 — "Payment to attendant". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that you can pay the fee to an attendant at this location. You must prepare to stop and make your payment manually.
meaning.nb: Skiltet viser at du kan betale avgiften til en betjent på dette stedet. Du må forberede deg på å stanse og utføre betalingen manuelt.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 285 — "Payment with coins to machine". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that you must pay the required fee using coins in the payment machine.
meaning.nb: Dette skiltet viser at du må betale den påkrevde avgiften med mynter i betalingsautomaten.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 285 — "Payment with card to machine". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that you can pay with a card at the payment machine.
meaning.nb: Dette skiltet viser at du kan betale med kort i betalingsautomaten.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 286 — "Payment with banknotes to machine". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that you can pay with banknotes at the payment machine.
meaning.nb: Skiltet viser at du kan betale med sedler i betalingsautomaten.

name.en: Remove ticket from closed payment system

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 286 — "Remove ticket from closed payment system". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You must remove your ticket from the machine in a closed payment system.
meaning.nb: Du må fjerne billetten fra apparatet i et lukket betalingssystem.

name.en: Use ticket in closed payment system

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 287 — "Use ticket in closed payment system". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You must use your ticket in the closed payment system as indicated.
meaning.nb: Du må bruke billetten din i det lukkede betalingssystemet som vist.

name.en: Automatic toll road, no stopping required

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 287 — "Automatic toll road, no stopping required". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You are approaching an automatic toll station. You can continue driving without stopping.
meaning.nb: Du nærmer deg en automatisk bomstasjon. Du kan kjøre videre uten å stoppe.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 288 — "Distance". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates the distance to the point where the regulation or condition shown on the main sign begins. It must be read in combination with the sign above it.
meaning.nb: Dette skiltet angir avstanden til stedet der reguleringen eller tilstanden som vises på hovedskiltet, trer i kraft. Det må leses sammen med skiltet over.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 288 — "Stretch". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates the distance over which the main sign applies, starting at the specified distance ahead.
meaning.nb: Dette skiltet angir strekningen som hovedskiltet gjelder for, regnet fra den angitte avstanden foran deg.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 288 — "Time". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign specifies the hours during which the main sign applies. Times in parentheses apply to Saturdays, and red times apply to Sundays.
meaning.nb: Dette skiltet angir tidsrommet hovedskiltet gjelder for. Klokkeslett i parentes gjelder lørdager, og røde klokkeslett gjelder søndager.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 288 — "Car". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that the main sign applies only to cars.
meaning.nb: Dette skiltet angir at hovedskiltet gjelder for personbil.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 288 — "Lorry". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that the main sign above applies to lorries. It specifies that the regulation or information is directed specifically at drivers of these vehicles.
meaning.nb: Dette skiltet angir at hovedskiltet ovenfor gjelder for lastebiler. Det presiserer at reguleringen eller informasjonen retter seg spesifikt mot førere av slike kjøretøy.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 289 — "Bus". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that the main sign only applies to buses.
meaning.nb: Skiltet angir at hovedskiltet gjelder for buss.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 289 — "Road train". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that the main sign applies to road trains consisting of a truck and trailer.
meaning.nb: Skiltet angir at hovedskiltet gjelder for vegtog bestående av lastebil og tilhenger.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 289 — "Trailer furnished for camping". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that the main sign applies to caravans.
meaning.nb: Dette skiltet angir at hovedskiltet gjelder for campingvogner.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 289 — "Bicycle". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that the main sign above applies to cyclists, or shows that cyclists use the designated lane or path.
meaning.nb: Dette skiltet viser at hovedskiltet over gjelder for syklende, eller viser at syklende bruker det angitte feltet eller veien.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 290 — "Motorcycle and moped". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that the main sign applies to motorcycles. It specifies that the regulation or information is valid for this vehicle category.
meaning.nb: Dette skiltet angir at hovedskiltet gjelder for motorsykkel. Det presiserer at reguleringen eller informasjonen gjelder for denne kjøretøykategorien.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 290 — "Driver with disabilities". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that the regulation above only applies to drivers with disabilities who hold a valid parking permit.
meaning.nb: Skiltet angir at regelen ovenfor kun gjelder for fører med funksjonsnedsettelse som innehar gyldig parkeringstillatelse.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 290 — "Vehicle furnished for camping". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that the main sign applies to or includes motorhomes.
meaning.nb: Skiltet angir at hovedskiltet gjelder for eller omfatter bobil.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 290 — "Text". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that the main sign above does not apply to buses and taxis.
meaning.nb: Dette skiltet viser at dethovedskiltet ovenfor ikke gjelder for buss og taxi.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 291 — "Turn arrow". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates the direction of the mandatory turn or the layout of the regulated movement shown above the sign.
meaning.nb: Skiltet viser retningen for påbudt sving eller utformingen av reguleringen som er vist på skiltet over.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 291 — "Recommended speed". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates the recommended speed under favorable conditions. You should adjust your driving to this speed if conditions permit.
meaning.nb: Skiltet angir anbefalt fart under gode forhold. Du bør tilpasse farten etter dette hvis forholdene tillater det.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 292 — "Degree of incline". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates the steepness of the road ahead in percentage. You must be aware that the road climbs or descends steeply.
meaning.nb: Dette skiltet angir stignings- eller fallgraden for veien foran deg i prosent. Du må være oppmerksom på at veien stiger eller faller bratt.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 292 — "Degree of incline". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates the degree of incline or decline on the road ahead and instructs you to use a low gear.
meaning.nb: Skiltet angir stigning eller fall på veien og påberoper at du bruker lavt gir.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 292 — "Actual available width". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates the actual available width of the roadway or passage. You must ensure your vehicle fits within this width before proceeding.
meaning.nb: Dette skiltet viser den faktiske tilgjengelige bredden på kjørebanen eller passasjen. Du må forsikre deg om at kjøretøyet ditt får plass innenfor denne bredden før du fortsetter.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 292 — "Crossing lumber transport". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that the road is crossed by lumber transport. You must watch out for tractors or vehicles transporting timber across the road.
meaning.nb: Underskiltet angir at veien krysses av tømmertransport. Du må være oppmerksom på traktorer eller kjøretøy som transporterer tømmer over veien.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 293 — "Particular danger of accidents". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates a road section with a particularly high frequency of accidents. You must exercise heightened caution and adapt your speed and driving behavior accordingly.
meaning.nb: Skiltet angir en vegstrekning med særlig hyppighet av ulykker. Du må vise ekstra aktsomhet og tilpasse farten og kjøringen deretter.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 293 — "Course of priority road". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign illustrates the course of the priority road at the upcoming intersection, shown by the thick line. You must follow the priority rules relative to the main road layout shown.
meaning.nb: Dette skiltet viser forløpet til forkjørsvegen i den kommende vegkryssingen, markert med den tykke streken. Du må følge vikepliksreglene i henhold til vegens viste utforming.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 293 — "Advance warning of stop sign". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates the distance to a mandatory stop sign ahead. You must prepare to stop completely at the upcoming intersection.
meaning.nb: Skiltet angir avstanden til et skilt med påbudt stans lenger fremme. Du må forberede deg på å stanse helt ved den kommende kryssingen.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 294 — "Bicycle traffic in both directions". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that bicycle traffic may occur in both directions on the road or path.
meaning.nb: Dette skiltet angir at sykkeltrafikk kan forekomme i begge retninger på veien eller stien.

name.en: Stopping or parking regulation sign applies in both directions
name.nb: Utstrekking av regulering for stans eller parkering

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 294 — "Stopping or parking regulation sign applies in both directions". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that the accompanying stopping or parking regulation applies both before and after the sign along the road.
meaning.nb: Dette skiltet angir at den medfølgende bestemmelsen om stans eller parkering gjelder både før og etter skiltet langs veien.

name.en: Stopping or parking regulation sign applies in the direction of the arrow

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 295 — "Stopping or parking regulation sign applies in the direction of the arrow". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that the stopping or parking regulation applies in the direction of the arrow, pointing downwards from the sign.
meaning.nb: Skiltet angir at stans- eller parkeringsreguleringen gjelder i pilens retning, som peker nedover fra skiltet.

name.en: Stopping or parking regulation sign applies in the direction of the arrow

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 295 — "Stopping or parking regulation sign applies in the direction of the arrow". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates that the accompanying stopping or parking regulation applies in the direction of the arrow.
meaning.nb: Dette skiltet angir at den medfølgende stans- eller parkeringsreguleringen gjelder i pilens retning.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 295 — "Arrangement for parked vehicles". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You must park your vehicle in accordance with the pattern shown on the sign, indicating the required angle relative to the curb or roadside.
meaning.nb: Du må parkere kjøretøyet i henhold til oppstillingsmåten som vises på skiltet, som angir påkrevd vinkel i forhold til kantstein eller veikant.

name.en: Parking duration board with parking disc

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 296 — "Parking board". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: You must use a parking disc when parking in this area. You cannot park longer than the maximum time indicated on the board.
meaning.nb: Du må bruke parkeringsskive når du parkerer på dette stedet. Du kan ikke parkere lenger enn den maksimale tiden som er angitt på skiltet.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 296 — "Combined regulation". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign specifies the times when the main sign applies. Times in parentheses apply to Saturdays, and times in brackets or red text apply to Sundays and public holidays.
meaning.nb: Dette underskiltet angir tidspunktene for når hovedskiltet gjelder. Tidspunkter i parentes gjelder lørdager, og tidspunkter i rød skrift gjelder søndager og helgedager.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 297 — "Background marker". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign warns you of a sharp curve or a sudden change in direction ahead, and guides you along the correct path.
meaning.nb: Skiltet varsler om en skarp sving eller plutselig retningsendring lenger fremme, og viser deg veien gjennom svingen.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 297 — "Background marker". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign warns you of a sharp change in the direction of the road. You must reduce your speed and follow the direction indicated by the chevrons.
meaning.nb: Skiltet varsler om en kraftig retningsendring på veien. Du må senke farten og følge retningen som markeres av vinklene.

meaning.en: This marker shows the alignment and edges of a tunnel wall. You must use it to help maintain orientation and position within the tunnel.
meaning.nb: Denne markeringen viser tunnelveggens plassering og avgrensning. Du må bruke den som hjelp til å bevare orienteringen og plasseringen inne i tunnelen.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 301 — "Tunnel marker". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This marker indicates the side walls and alignment of a tunnel. You must use it to help guide your vehicle safely through the tunnel.
meaning.nb: Denne markeringen viser tunnelens sidevegger og linjeføring. Du må bruke den som en veiledning for å holde kjøretøyet ditt trygt gjennom tunnelen.

signs.sourceNote: Norwegian Driving Licence Theory, chapter 10, page 301 — "Distance marker for tunnels". Replace with the official Statens vegvesen asset.

meaning.en: This sign indicates the distance to the nearest exit or emergency shelter in a tunnel. It helps you orient yourself regarding your position inside the tunnel.
meaning.nb: Dette skiltet viser avstanden til nærmeste utgang eller nødrom i en tunnel. Det hjelper deg med å orientere deg om din posisjon inne i tunnelen.

meaning.en: This marker shows you the edge of the road, helping you navigate safely especially in the dark or poor visibility.
meaning.nb: Denne markeringen viser deg vegkanten og hjelper deg med å orientere deg trygt, spesielt i mørket eller ved dårlig sikt.

meaning.en: This post marks the edge of the road to help you navigate, especially in poor visibility or darkness. The reflector shows which side of the road you are on.

meaning.nb: Denne stolpen markerer vegkanten for å hjelpe deg med å orientere deg, særlig ved dårlig sikt eller i mørke.

meaning.en: This marker indicates a road closure, obstruction, or an area of the road you must not enter. You must respect the barrier and choose an alternative route.
meaning.nb: Denne markeringen angir vegsperring, hinder eller et område av vegen du ikke har tillatelse til å kjøre inn på. Du må respektere sperringen og velge en alternativ rute.

meaning.en: You must respect the temporary guidance or barrier marked by the cone, as it indicates a hazard or a change in the traffic layout ahead.
meaning.nb: Du må respektere den midlertidige ledningen eller avstengningen som markeres av kjeglen, da den viser en fare eller en endring i trafikkleiet lenger frem.

meaning.en: This marker indicates an obstruction in the roadway or guides traffic past temporary work zones. You must pass on the side indicated by other signs or road markings.
